title: Polymarket is making it harder to use VPNs to access its service, blocking some IPs and suspicious accounts, and is asking some customers to identify themselves (Michael Roddan/The Information)
summary: Michael Roddan / The Information: Polymarket is making it harder to use VPNs to access its service, blocking some IPs and suspicious accounts, and is asking some customers to identify themselves — In Russia, making bets on Polymarket isn't permitted by the popular online prediction market's rules.
